---
title: "All posts"
subtitle: "Everything, newest first. Use the categories to narrow it down."
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  # Matches the ISO date on the post pages themselves. Listing `date-format` is
  # separate from the one in posts/_metadata.yml — setting only that one leaves
  # cards reading "Aug 12, 2026" next to posts reading "2026-08-12".
  date-format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
  categories: true
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: true
  # partial, not full. A full feed embeds each post's entire rendered body,
  # interactive-figure JSON included — that made blog.xml 7.2 MB.
  feed:
    type: partial
  fields: [date, title, description, categories, reading-time]
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
toc: false
---
